---
title: "iLand goes Linux"
date: "2009-09-10"
author: "Werner Rammer"
---

Up and then I think about switching to Linux, and up and then I install a Linux version somewhere on my harddrive, boot it up, play around, get stuck (usually, WLAN drivers play a role here), and soon after that I give it up. Recently, I tried [Virtul Box](http://www.virtualbox.org/) and here the experience differed significantly: I installed a Ubuntu 9.04, rebooted the virtual machine and (almost) everything worked nice from the start.
Two evenings later, I had it all up and running: the iLand-sourcecode from a SVN-Repository, compiled with [Qt Creator](http://qt.nokia.com/products/developer-tools) and running on [KDE 4.3](http://www.kde.org).
